controls: development cases only; no reserved questions
historical control questions retained byte-for-byte; six new questions and evidence bound to the supplemental registry hash
one question-only fixed suffix for every case; no case-specific branches, model calls, source terms or evaluator inputs
same semantic search fields, configuration and candidate depth for original and expanded queries
original, expanded and fused views each have a five-passage final context budget
required evidence identities and hashes are evaluator-only and never enter a request
exact 18-record historical corpus fingerprint and configuration hashes checked before and after
one call per query; no retry, repair or within-batch tuning
supplemental case review must name an independent reviewer and bind unchanged case contents before freezing or execution
interpretation: Compare evidence completeness per case, not answer correctness or behavior routing.
An exact evidence hit must match document, heading, source revision and text hash.
Fixed-rule success on reused development questions does not establish independent generalization; the rule was designed after earlier results.
Fusion may use a larger candidate pool but must not exceed the unchanged five-passage context budget.
A regression occurs when original top-five evidence is complete and either expanded or fused top five loses required evidence.
Ambiguous questions still require clarification behavior even if retrieval becomes complete.
If configuration or corpus changes, invalidate the comparison; if authentication fails, stop without retry.
Report deduplicated candidate union and full fused ranks separately from all final five-passage views.
AI001-025 remains an unresolved control; do not tune another force-commit rewrite within this batch.
Compare arms within this run; manual comparison 01 is historical context, not a simultaneous control.
Report new-development (six) and historical-control (five) completeness separately; combined eleven-case results are secondary.
Report fusion losses relative to complete expanded views as well as regressions relative to complete originals.
Draft authored by Codex after checkpoint 15; do not claim independent authorship, blindness or human review before it occurs.
